item.title: Switching costs: the hidden barrier to MMC adoption
item.author: shawn@shawnkeyes.com (Shawn Keyes)
item.description: Why modern methods of construction stall at 7.5% of Canadian construction. Read through Hamilton Helmer's 7 Powers, the real obstacle isn't the factory price tag - it's the financial, procedural, and relational cost of doing something new, and five strategies exist to beat it.
